name: mesa
description: Provides libraries and drivers for graphics APIs like OpenGL and Vulkan, including libGL, libEGL, libgbm, and Gallium3D/VA-API drivers.
build: meson setup mesa-25.3.5/build mesa-25.3.5 --prefix=$XORG_PREFIX --buildtype=release -D platforms=x11,wayland -D gallium-drivers=auto -D vulkan-drivers=auto -D valgrind=disabled -D video-codecs=all -D libunwind=disabled
